title: Bug: Race condition in enabling monitoring during config reload
author: tirupatihemanth
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

There is a race condition in the implementation of config reload in sonic code. 

During config reload -y -f we ask monit to unmonitor container_checker to avoid errors as containers go down. And during restarting as part of the reload we ask monit to monitor container_checker again. For this we using "monit monitor container_checker" command. Please see below 


https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/blob/cbb31f0d65c6768107f2089f6c75a617d8b519b4/config/main.py#L1058C1-L1068C55

```
    try:
        subprocess.check_call(['sudo', 'monit', 'status'], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        click.echo("Enabling container and routeCheck monitoring ...")
        clicommon.run_command(['sudo', 'monit', 'monitor', 'routeCheck'])
        clicommon.run_command(['sudo', 'monit', 'monitor', 'container_checker'])
        time.sleep(1)
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as err:
        pass
    # Reload Monit configuration to pick up new hostname in case it changed
    click.echo("Reloading Monit configuration ...")
    clicommon.run_command(['sudo', 'monit', 'reload'])
```

However, monit monitor is an asynchronous command and doesn't wait for the action to be done and returns immediately. usually the operation is finished within a second and that is the reason behind very low probability reproduction. However config reload is a cpu intensive process and in our situation this action was not scheduled within the second. 

Here is the failure case log sequence
 
```
syslog:4815:2026 Feb  8 12:46:20.088975 sonic INFO monit[312345]: 'routeCheck' monitor on user request
syslog:4818:2026 Feb  8 12:46:20.127129 sonic INFO monit[312345]: 'routeCheck' monitor action done
syslog:4822:2026 Feb  8 12:46:20.129079 sonic INFO monit[312345]: 'container_checker' monitor on user request

syslog:4937:2026 Feb  8 12:46:21.160832 sonic INFO monit[316880]: Reinitializing monit daemon
syslog:4939:2026 Feb  8 12:46:21.164852 sonic INFO monit[312345]: Reinitializing Monit -- control file '/etc/monit/monitrc'
syslog:4992:2026 Feb  8 12:46:22.131899 sonic INFO monit[312345]: 'sonic' Monit reloaded
```
Here is the healthy case log sequence 
```
syslog.5:3408:2026 Feb  8 12:21:10.925215 sonic INFO monit[1196]: 'routeCheck' monitor on user request
syslog.5:3411:2026 Feb  8 12:21:10.951078 sonic INFO monit[1196]: 'routeCheck' monitor action done
syslog.5:3412:2026 Feb  8 12:21:10.965341 sonic INFO monit[1196]: 'container_checker' monitor on user request
syslog.5:3415:2026 Feb  8 12:21:11.007043 sonic INFO monit[1196]: 'container_checker' monitor action done

syslog.5:3557:2026 Feb  8 12:21:12.005919 sonic INFO monit[260153]: Reinitializing monit daemon
syslog.5:3558:2026 Feb  8 12:21:12.006214 sonic INFO monit[1196]: Reinitializing Monit -- control file '/etc/monit/monitrc'
syslog.5:3607:2026 Feb  8 12:21:12.972726 sonic INFO monit[1196]: 'sonic' Monit reloaded
```

During monit reload, monit saves and restores monitoring state and since container_checker was not enabled so it will forever remained unmonitored from this point onwards. 

​

### Steps to Reproduce

Execute config reload -y -f  (low probability of reproduction)

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Expected behaviour: After config reload we should have container_checker monitor enabled.

linkedPullRequests.author: tirupatihemanth
linkedPullRequests.body:
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/25599

    your changes.

    Please provide the following information:
-->

#### What I did
Wait for monit monitor <service> operation to complete before monit reload operation

#### Why I did
There is a race condition in the implementation of config reload in sonic code. 

During config reload -y -f we ask monit to unmonitor container_checker to avoid errors as containers go down. And during restarting as part of the reload we ask monit to monitor container_checker again. For this we using "monit monitor container_checker" command. This is an async operation. Please see below 


https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/blob/cbb31f0d65c6768107f2089f6c75a617d8b519b4/config/main.py#L1058C1-L1068C55

```
    try:
        subprocess.check_call(['sudo', 'monit', 'status'], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        click.echo("Enabling container and routeCheck monitoring ...")
        clicommon.run_command(['sudo', 'monit', 'monitor', 'routeCheck'])
        clicommon.run_command(['sudo', 'monit', 'monitor', 'container_checker'])
        time.sleep(1)
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as err:
        pass
    # Reload Monit configuration to pick up new hostname in case it changed
    click.echo("Reloading Monit configuration ...")
    clicommon.run_command(['sudo', 'monit', 'reload'])
```

During monit reload, monit saves and restores monitoring state and since container_checker was not enabled so it will forever remained unmonitored from this point onwards.

#### How to verify it
monit checkers will not be left in not monitored state after config reload
